The estimated average treatment effect is about 3.93 points on the cognitive test score. I got this from an OLS regression of the outcome `y` on treatment plus all 25 covariates (x1–x25).

The data has no counterfactual outcomes, so the true effect can't be read off directly. The raw difference in mean `y` between treated and control children is 4.19, but that figure ignores confounding, so I used the adjusted estimate instead.

ANSWER: 3.93
